protocol_training.reward_B_condition: all three algorithms complete A; no A model has zero physical failures, >=95% validation success AND lower mean actual cost than selected PID
protocol_training.formal_selection: eligible means >=95% passes, zero physical failures, selected checkpoint steps > 0; most passes then lowest penalized selection cost then earliest checkpoint then fixed algorithm order as exact tie break; step-zero PID fallback is not a learned success
protocol_training.primary_cost_requirement: PID and every formal seed pass every in-domain test; all corrected paired cost confidence intervals below zero
protocol_training.primary_success_requirement: every seed paired success improvement interval above zero; no additional physical failures

prehistory: repeat initial measurement; zero commands; zero valid count
anti_windup: conditional integration uses final total command and final total raw torque

reward.failure: each remaining interval costs the maximum legal ordinary rate cost plus one
reward.terminal: 440 samples only; no time-limit bootstrap; failures remain absorbing until sample 440
reward.shaping_property: discounted shaping sums to minus the common initial potential; terminal potential is exactly zero

model_selection: fewest physical failures, most passes, lowest penalized_selection_cost, earliest checkpoint
initialization: actor deterministic mean exactly zero; initial checkpoint retained and evaluated; zero residual is exactly the selected PID
ideal_sanity: direct continuous action, lag physical plant with T=0, initial angle +/-20deg and rate +/-2deg/s
optimizer_step_count_definition: actual calls to each Torch optimizer.step; SB3 _n_updates is retained separately
